issue.title: 3 prompt-panel monitor tests render an empty monitor section (TESTING/FAILED missing)
issue.description:
Found by the sase-17z land agent at master 71736697d (pristine tree via git stash, and
in a worktree at 7e1b05964^ — so it predates the agent-session wire cutover and
sase-17z).

Three prompt-panel monitor tests fail deterministically:

- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_prompt_panel_monitor.py::test_monitor_section_dims_the_inactive_status_half
  — `AssertionError: 'TESTING' not found in rendered monitor section`
- ...::test_family_monitor_phase_decodes_ansi_and_drops_escapes — `assert 'FAILED' in ''`
- ...::test_starter_monitor_phase_decodes_ansi_and_drops_escapes — `assert 'FAILED' in ''`

The rendered monitor section/phase text comes back empty or without the status label.
Root cause not investigated; last test-file touch was 5a048ceb3 (sase-17m.3.1.4
agent_session field rename) — candidates are that rename, the recent monitor
recovery/presentation commits (addeb78f5, 15fa55e5e), or deck cutover work. Bisect
between those commits and fix the renderer or test fixture accordingly.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails identically on every run: pristine master 71736697d, and detached worktrees at 7e1b05964^, 7e1b05964, bda83083b, 9bd351b67.
